news.title: Jain Honored for Outstanding Contributions to Scientific Medicine
news.summary_en: Saint Louis University Professor of Pediatrics Ajay Jain, M.D., has earned the St. Louis Metropolitan Medicine Award of Merit. The St. Louis Metropolitan Medicine Society recognized Jain for his national leadership in pediatric gastroenterology and nutrition, excellence in research and clinical innovation, and advancing pediatric care, physician leadership, and organized medicine.

news.title: SLU’s President Meets Pope Leo XIV During Gathering of Jesuit University Leaders in Rome
news.summary_en: The presidents of 19 Jesuit colleges and universities in North America recently traveled to Rome for a series of meetings coordinated by the Association of Jesuit Colleges and Universities (AJCU). SLU President Edward Feser, Ph.D., who was joined by his wife Kathy Feser, said it was “deeply moving” to hear from and pray alongside the Holy Father.
